name: After § 5
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the recent hybrid attacks and instrumentalisation of migrants in Ceuta and the need for a coordinated response to protect the EU’s external borders
part_text: 5b. Recalls that its resolution of 10 June 2021, cited above, condemned the use of minors by the Moroccan authorities as a breach of the UN Convention on the Rights of the Child; considers that the EU cannot condemn a third country for using children as leverage and simultaneously treat those same children primarily as subjects for return;
